description: Bank already declined an identical mandate registration; NPCI blocks duplicate retries.
Payment amount is below the bank's fixed minimum/fee threshold.
razorpay_guidance: Raise amount above the bank minimum.

description: 3DS/OTP authentication failed - customer cancelled at the OTP screen or entered wrong details.
UPI PSP app rejected the authorisation request; often PSP downtime or a VPA problem.
razorpay_guidance: Recheck VPA and retry, or switch PSP app.

description: Bank account is not valid - closed by the customer or the bank.
razorpay_guidance: Use a valid account or another method; re-register mandate.

description: Third-party validation of the supplied bank account details failed.
Bank core-banking cutoff window in progress - a periodic, scheduled bank event.
Bank unavailable due to downtime or a technical issue.
Selected bank is not enabled on the merchant account.
razorpay_guidance: Merchant must ask Razorpay to enable the bank.

description: Issuing/destination bank core banking system hit a technical error during processing.
razorpay_guidance: Retry later or use another bank account.

description: Beneficiary account does not exist.
Beneficiary account is dormant.
Payment capture step failed.
Issuer declined the card without a more specific reason.
razorpay_guidance: Retry with a different card or method.

description: Card has passed its expiry date.
razorpay_guidance: Customer must use a valid card.

description: Card network (Visa/Mastercard/etc.) not enabled for the merchant.
razorpay_guidance: Merchant must ask Razorpay to enable the network.

description: Card is not enrolled for this payment method.
razorpay_guidance: Enrol the card or use another.

description: Card number does not match any valid BIN/IIN.
razorpay_guidance: Customer must enter a valid card number.

description: Card type is not valid for this transaction.
UPI Collect is blocked for this merchant category code.
A UPI collect request is already pending for this transaction.
razorpay_guidance: Wait for the pending request to resolve.

description: Payment violates a compliance requirement.
razorpay_guidance: Ensure the payment meets compliance rules.

description: Credit processing failed.
Customer's credit limit has been exceeded.
razorpay_guidance: Reduce amount or use another method.

description: Customer's credit limit has expired.
razorpay_guidance: Renew limit or use another method.

description: Customer's credit limit is inactive.
razorpay_guidance: Activate limit or use another method.

description: Customer's credit limit is not approved.
razorpay_guidance: Get limit approved or use another method.

description: Credit transactions are not permitted for this customer.
Debit transaction declined by the issuer.
Card or account is blocked by the issuer or by the customer.
razorpay_guidance: Use a different instrument; customer may need to contact their bank.

description: Card or account is inactive or frozen; withdrawals temporarily blocked.
razorpay_guidance: Activate the instrument or contact the bank.

description: Transaction is deemed and cannot be processed.
A refund with this ID already exists.
An identical payment request was already sent; the gateway blocks duplicates.
Duplicate retrieval reference number detected.
EMI amount exceeds the maximum allowed.
razorpay_guidance: Reduce amount or use another method.

description: Requested EMI plan is unavailable.
razorpay_guidance: Choose a different plan or method.

description: Funds are locked by an existing mandate on the account.
razorpay_guidance: Release the mandate or use another account.

description: Gateway server hit a technical error while processing the payment.
Incorrect ATM PIN entered.
razorpay_guidance: Customer must enter the correct PIN.

description: Incorrect card details entered.
razorpay_guidance: Customer must correct the card details.

description: Incorrect card expiry date entered.
razorpay_guidance: Customer must enter the correct expiry date.

description: Incorrect cardholder name entered.
razorpay_guidance: Customer must correct the cardholder name.

description: Incorrect CVV entered.
razorpay_guidance: Customer must retry with the correct CVV.

description: Stored bank IFSC code is no longer valid.
Incorrect OTP entered.
razorpay_guidance: Customer must retry with the correct OTP.

description: Incorrect PIN entered.
razorpay_guidance: Customer must retry with the correct PIN.

description: Payment request contained wrong or malformed parameters.
razorpay_guidance: Merchant must fix the request parameters.

description: Account does not hold enough balance to complete the payment.
razorpay_guidance: Retry once the customer has funds, or use another method.

description: International transactions are not permitted on this instrument.
razorpay_guidance: Use a domestic method or enable international.

description: Amount or currency in the request is unsupported or malformed.
razorpay_guidance: Merchant must fix the amount field.

description: Currency passed is unsupported or invalid.
Device used is invalid for this transaction.
Email address provided is invalid.
Mobile number provided is invalid.
Order ID is missing or invalid; it is mandatory for every payment.
Request is malformed.
razorpay_guidance: Check the request format and retry.

description: Gateway returned a malformed response.
User details provided are invalid.
Customer entered an incorrect UPI VPA.
Card issuer hit a technical error.
razorpay_guidance: Retry later or use another card.

description: Mandate attempted on a joint account; banks usually require sole-ownership accounts.
Test-mode keys used against live mode.
Mandate creation declined.
razorpay_guidance: Retry mandate creation or use another method.

description: Mandate creation request expired.
Mandate creation failed.
razorpay_guidance: Retry mandate creation or use another method.

description: Mandate creation timed out.
Registered mandate is no longer active; cancelled by customer or bank.
Amount limit for this merchant category code exceeded.
razorpay_guidance: Reduce the amount or contact Razorpay.

description: Merchant account is not activated.
Transaction details do not match across the request.
Mobile number is invalid.
Order already has a successful payment; only one is allowed per order ID.
razorpay_guidance: Check order status before retrying; use a fresh order ID.

description: Amount in the order differs from the amount in the payment request.
razorpay_guidance: Pass the same amount in both requests.

description: Method in the order differs from the method in the payment request.
razorpay_guidance: Do not pass method on order creation.

description: OTP retry limit exceeded; issuer may temporarily block the card.
razorpay_guidance: Retry later or use another method.

description: OTP has expired.
Payment amount was altered in transit.
Customer explicitly cancelled the payment or instructed their bank to cancel.
razorpay_guidance: Customer must retry to complete the payment.

description: UPI collect request expired before the customer approved it.
Bank or gateway declined for business/technical reasons not communicated to Razorpay.
razorpay_guidance: Retry later or use another method.

description: Gateway declined due to high traffic load.
Bank or wallet gateway failed the payment with no specific error code returned.
razorpay_guidance: Retry with a different payment method.

description: Mandate is registered but not yet activated at the bank.
Selected payment method is not enabled on the merchant account.
razorpay_guidance: Merchant must ask Razorpay to enable the method.

description: Payment is pending and not yet complete.
Payment awaits approval under a maker-checker or bank approval flow.
razorpay_guidance: Wait for approval or retry later.

description: Declined by a risk check at Razorpay, the gateway, or the issuer; source indicates which.
razorpay_guidance: Do not retry the same instrument; inform or escalate.

description: Payment session expired.
Customer did not complete within the window, or no gateway response was received.
razorpay_guidance: Retry and complete within the time window.

description: PIN retry limit exceeded.
No PIN is set for the payment method.
UPI PSP app unavailable, typically PSP downtime.
UPI app is not supported or is blacklisted.
PSP is not available.
PSP is not registered.
razorpay_guidance: Register with a PSP or use another.

description: Requested record was not found.
Recurring payments are not enabled on the account.
Refund limit crossed.
Mandate authentication request was not acknowledged.
Request timed out.
Technical error on Razorpay's servers.
Daily transaction count limit exceeded.
razorpay_guidance: Wait for the next day or use another method.

description: Customer exceeded the daily transaction limit set on the card.
razorpay_guidance: Use another instrument or wait 24 hours.

description: NPCI per-day frequency limit exhausted by the customer.
Customer exceeded the per-transaction credit/debit limit on the instrument.
razorpay_guidance: Customer must raise their limit or use another method.

description: Transactions on this VPA are temporarily or permanently blocked by the PSP.
razorpay_guidance: Customer must use a different UPI ID.

description: Technical error at the customer's UPI PSP.
razorpay_guidance: Retry, or try a different UPI app.

description: UPI Autopay not supported on this PSP.
UPI Collect flow not enabled on the merchant account.
UPI Intent flow not enabled on the merchant account.
Customer failed a credit eligibility check (poor score or insufficient documents).
Customer's bank account is not registered for netbanking.
Payment verification via the status-check API failed.
UPI network could not resolve/validate the VPA.
razorpay_guidance: Use a different account or method.
